categories.main_business_segments: Giant Biogene Holding Co., Ltd primarily operates in the beauty and health sectors, focusing on professional skin treatment products including functional skincare products and medical dressings, as well as functional foods. The company markets its products mainly under the Comfy and Collgene brands, with Comfy focusing on medical device and cosmetics synergy and Collgene targeting anti-aging skincare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced biotechnology, particularly recombinant collagen technologies including Type XVII and Type IV collagen, and rare ginsenosides. It employs innovative production methods such as efficient expression of recombinant human collagen in CHO cells and uses two-photon microscopy imaging for product efficacy demonstration. The company also develops class III medical devices and maintains smart manufacturing with multiple production lines for collagen, cosmetics, and medical devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Giant Biogene serves a broad customer base including public and private hospitals, clinics, pharmacy chains, cosmetic store chains, supermarkets, and direct consumers through online and offline retail channels. Its products cater to consumers with skin problems, medical professionals, and beauty and health markets across China, with growing presence in premium retail channels and international duty-free markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with extensive distribution across approximately 1,700 public hospitals, 3,000 private hospitals and clinics, 130,000 pharmacies, and 6,000 cosmetics chains and supermarkets nationwide. It has expanded retail presence in key Chinese cities such as Xi’an, Chongqing, Chengdu, and Sanya, and has entered premium channels in Hong Kong and international duty-free markets like cdf Sanya.
categories.supply_chain_position: Giant Biogene operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on research and development, manufacturing, and direct sales of bioactive ingredients, skincare products, and medical devices. It controls production through its own manufacturing facilities and distributes products via direct sales and distributor networks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, increasing it by 42% in 2024, focusing on recombinant collagen and rare ginsenosides. It aims to advance class III medical device development and clinical registration, expand product portfolios with innovative skincare and medical products, and enhance global market expansion. The company also emphasizes scientific communication and brand building to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Giant Biogene generates revenue primarily through product sales of professional skin treatment products and functional foods. Sales channels include direct online sales via e-commerce platforms and self-operated stores, offline direct sales through flagship and experience stores, and sales through distributors to hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and retail chains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a global leader in recombinant collagen technology, with Euromonitor International acknowledging its leadership. It holds a top-tier industry position in China’s beauty and health market, competing through technological innovation, strong brand equity, and extensive distribution networks. Specific competitors are not named, but the company emphasizes its technological moat and market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Giant Biogene reported revenue of RMB 5.54 billion in 2024, a 57.2% increase year-on-year, with adjusted net profit of RMB 2.15 billion, up 46.5%. The company has shown consistent growth over five years, expanding assets and equity significantly. It maintains strong profitability with gross profit margin above 82% and no bank borrowings, reflecting a robust financial position and rapid growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary recombinant collagen and rare ginsenoside ingredients, backed by extensive patents and scientific research. Its products combine medical device efficacy with cosmetic appeal, offering professional, effective, and safe solutions for diverse skin conditions. Strong brand equity, scenario-based product development, and scientific communication enhance consumer trust and loyalty, supporting premium positioning in the beauty and health markets.
